source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider_row = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and r > 0 and r < h - 1)
    divider_col = next(c for c in range(w) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1 and c > 0 and c < w - 1)
    top_h, left_w = divider_row, divider_col
    bottom_h, right_w = h - divider_row - 1, w - divider_col - 1
    tile_h, tile_w = min(top_h, bottom_h), min(left_w, right_w)
    tile = [row[divider_col + 1:divider_col + 1 + tile_w] for row in grid[divider_row + 1:divider_row + 1 + tile_h]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0 in (0, divider_row + 1):
        for c0 in (0, divider_col + 1):
            for dr in range(tile_h):
                for dc in range(tile_w):
                    out[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = tile[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
